set_from: The owner's allocation of 2026-09-19 (fn-89 Conversation Evidence): Jev routes over explicit evidence, a cheap agent conducts, a high-reasoning model designs at medium effort, implementation is chosen again from the design, and any unjustified next attempt is the human's. Held out in data/cases/conductor.json.

tiers.cheap: the cheap effective agent named by the instruction file's routing block
tiers.high_reasoning: the high-reasoning model named by the instruction file's routing block

rows.why: a hard limit is reached; no budget reset without the human
the continuation judgment is unavailable or unvalidated
the next attempt is unjustified: uncertainty, unusual complexity, implementation risk or no supported path
repeated attempts without progress, budget remaining or not
the strongest implementation allocation failed verification
difficult implementation failed at low effort; increased effort, not a repeat
straightforward work failed on the cheap tier; a stronger model at low effort
the design did not resolve its unknowns; design again at high effort
no match or missing evidence: investigate rather than guess a cheap route
routine work runs on the cheap agent
complex design goes to a high-reasoning model at medium effort
the design leaves unknowns that need further design
missing design evidence or contradictory judgments: investigate
the design did the complex work; a cheap model implements
implementation is still complex; a high-reasoning model starts at low effort
no row justified an unattended route

decisions.note: Decision kinds a cheap agent may resolve under policy, with the options it may choose; every other kind and option is the owner's. Lowering a bar, overriding a ruling or changing a boundary is never routine.
